column2: Hmm, looks like you got it wrong. There are a lot of them, I know, but stay sharp.
Okay, I'll explain once more. Ready?
Next, I need you to go put two flowers in each room.
So first, Tsuruko-san loves roses, so a rose and... a lily.
Next, Kikyo-san's full of pep, so a tulip and a sunflower.
Next, Shizuku-san's cute, so a gerbera and a tulip.
...No, let's make that lavender.
Next, Namio-san doesn't care either way, but let's say a sunflower and a tulip.
Next, Kokoro-san gets lavender and... what should the other one be?
Hmm, let's see... let's go with a rose.
Next, Rokuro-san gets a sunflower and a tulip.
And last, Hakama-san gets... Huh? Weren't we out of roses?
...Then skip Kokoro-san's rose and give her a lily instead.
So Hakama-san gets a rose and a tulip. She gets mad if there's no rose.
I'll put the flowers in your Event items.
You can only place items from the front of the desk, so be careful.
Oh, and you can't stack the flowers on top of each other.
Okay, I'm counting on you.
Ah, looks like that's wrong... This is the last one, so let's give it our all!!
Okay, listen carefully.
First, Tsuruko-san -- her costume hasn't arrived, so you don't need to place one.
Next, Kikyo-san gets the flashy kimono.
She might not look it, but she really loves flashy stuff.
Shizuku-san's next: the demure kimono. Gotta love a gal in a demure kimono.
Then Namio-san gets the men's hakama.
Don't go delivering the hakama to Hakama-san by mistake.
It goes to Namio-san, got it?
Next up, Kokoro-san gets the flashy... oh, no, the demure dress.
Next, Rokuro-san gets the tuxedo.
And last, Hakama-san gets...
Huh? Hakama-san's costume hadn't arrived either, right?
I forget whether it's Tsuruko-san or Hakama-san who gets the flashy dress.
Oh well, just do whatever.
I'll put the costumes in your Event items.
You can only place items from the front of the desk, so be careful.
Ban-chan, what do we do?
Ban-chan, there's an oncoming car!!
Ban-chan, falling rocks ahead!!
Almost there, Ban-chan!!
Uh-oh, my voice is gone... Anyone got a throat lozenge? A throat lozenge...
What good's hitting the brakes here?!
No way I'll hit 'em from here!!
No good! We're gonna slam into the guardrail!!
Tch, they've pulled ahead!
Can't swerve with the guardrail there!
...Like that's gonna work!
No good! The ladybug doesn't have the horsepower!
That's useless! All they'd have to do is hit the brakes!
Jeez, you still get worked up at the drop of a hat. You haven't changed a bit...
What? Quit treating me like a kid all the time!
...Besides, I haven't forgiven you yet...
...Fine. I'll take you on anytime.
If that's what you want... that is.
Oh, it's Shido and Madoka-chan~! Yoo-hoo!
...What, you heading out?
That's right~ As of now, these boys are my servants. Right♥?
Ban-chan can't even pay, but he swore he'd pay back Hevn-san's gas money...
...ten times over~...
Tch, if we'd just gotten a decent fee for once, this wouldn't...
And so, you two are going to work your fingers to the bone for me all day today.
Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho!
That sounds rough for the GetBackers...
When those guys are around, it's nothing but yapping and racket.
It's nicer and quieter without 'em.
Sure got quiet in here... Maybe I'll put the radio on.
Oh, this is that song that's super popular right now, isn't it?
The one that girl MAI sings!
What's wrong, Madoka?
Not a fan of this kind of song? Want me to change it?
No, it's not that. It's just that it sounds kind of lonely...
She didn't used to sing like this...
Huh? Madoka-san, you know MAI?
Yes, she... Mai Sakamoto was my best friend in high school.
We were aiming in different directions musically, but we got along really well...
Good friends and good rivals, that kind of thing?
Yes... Even back then, she dreamed of becoming a singer.
Now that her dream has come true, maybe she's happy, but...
But something's off... Right?
...Yes.
Your hunch might be right on, Madoka-chan.
That MAI girl's with Yamashiro Productions, right?
I don't hear good things about that place.
Huh? What do you mean?
They ignore what their artists want and make 'em sing whatever sells,
and once they're not popular anymore, they toss 'em... so they say.
Plus, most of their staff are from the underworld.
...Want me to take it back?
...Huh?
That MAI's singing voice, I mean.
But...
You're always looking out for me, Madoka. Think of this as my thanks.
...Well, I'm off.
Shido-san's all fired up 'cause Madoka-san's here, huh, Al-kun?
...Al-kun, what's wrong?
...What's gotten into Al-kun, I wonder?
Beats me...
So this is Yamashiro Productions...
...What do you want? You got business with our agency?
I need to talk to MAI. Let me through, would ya?
Oh, sure thing.
...You think anybody'd actually let you through?
You came to snoop around in our business, didn't you?
I don't care about any of that. I just wanna talk to MAI.
I'm not looking to stir up trouble either.
Like anyone'd believe that. Hey, you guys, we've got a guest!
Show him some proper hospitality!
Shido-haaaaan! I've come to save yaaaaa!!
Phew, did a good deed there~! Real "here comes the hero" vibe, huh?
...Emishi, what's with that getup...
This? The first round of the comedy audition is a mascot suit round.
Like, "Aim for comedy stardom!" ya know.
So you here for the audition too, Shido-han?
As if. I'm here on a job. A job.
Well, if that's the deal, I'll lend ya a hand!
...Thing is, I've been thinkin' for a while now, this agency's a little off.
Off?
Every last one of the folks workin' here reeks of somethin' shady.
I was just thinkin' I'd do some snoopin' on my own, even without you, Shido-han.
Wouldn't do for a future star to work someplace shady, ya know.
...If that's how it is, do what you want.
All right! Then it's settled, you gotta go in disguise too, Shido-han!!
!? Hey, what're you doing?
Disguise is the basics of undercover work! C'mon, hurry it up!
Looks great on ya!
How 'bout it, Shido-han, wanna form a comedy duo with me?
Like hell I would!
Wait up, Shido-han!
...Just now, person of Sand element, was close by, I think...??
...But anyway... Where is here???
Sorry, dear, we're cleaning the stairs. Could you come back a little later?
Can't be helped. Shall we go kill some time somewhere, Shido-han?
...Hm? I hear something. It's coming from inside this room!
The cat took a cat nap!!
Eat mori soba, mori and more!!!
The double bed is seeing double!!!
...N-no good... This guy's no good! Zero sense of humor!!
...And I know that voice...
Ahh, you're... Juubei-han, ain't ya!
Ngh, don't look!
Juubei-han... What MakubeX-han said to you...
You're still hung up on it?
Comin' all the way out to an audition like this...
Turns out he's the type to hold a grudge...
I know! Juubei-han, why don't ya come along with us?
Leave me alone!
Leave him be. Even he's got his pride...
Aw, what a shame...
So you're the ones who took down our guys at the entrance!!
Shido-han!!
I know! Let's go, Emishi!!
...Jeez, this is getting us nowhere! I'm taking this mascot suit off!!
...Can't be helped!!
Man, maybe it's from wearin' that mascot suit till now, but I'm beat.
And whose fault is that?!
Tch, getting bogged down by small fry like these...!
Shido! Are you okay?!
You guys... what're you doing here?
Madoka-chan told us.
She was worried 'cause you went off all by yourself, Shido.
But Emishi was with you, huh.
Howdy!
...I don't remember asking for help.
We're here 'cause the young lady hired us. It's business, business!
...Tch!
Now, now, everybody play nice!
All right, let's get fired up and go!!
